title: Legendary actions
html:
This page is about content exclusive to Honour mode.

Legendary actions are a type of resource available to some characters while in Honour mode. A character with a legendary action will have an associated passive and condition - while the condition is active, the character can use their legendary action. Once per round,[note 1] a character may use their legendary action, often as a reaction to being dealt damage. Legendary actions restore at the beginning of a new round.

While in Tactician, dragons will also have legendary actions available.

List of legendary actions

See Category:Legendary actions for a list, or Category:Honour mode for Honour exclusive content.

Act One

Character Action
Auntie Ethel
Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge
Once per round, Auntie Ethel can spend a Legendary Action to summon more illusory duplicates and shuffle herself among them after a spell is cast.
Bernard
Legendary Action: Leaping Static
Once per round, Bernard can spend a Legendary Action to immediately launch  Leaping Static at a foe after being attacked.
Bulette
Legendary Action: Shredding Scales
Once per turn, the Bulette can spend a Legendary Action to use  Shredding Scales after being hit if its  Diamond Scales are active.
Dror Ragzlin
 Arachnid Compulsion
Take control of nearby spiders with a borrowed piece of drow magic.
Legendary Action: Devoted Galvanism
Once per round when an enemy targets their ally with an ability, Dror Ragzlin can use a Legendary Action to  Galvanise Absolutists within 5 m (17 ft), granting them  Action Surge.
Grym
Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation
Once per round, Grym can use its Legendary Action to  Reverberate when it is struck, doubling its movement and granting it 10 temporary hit points.
Nere
Legendary Action: Psionic Visage
Once per round, Nere can use his Legendary Action to cast  Psionic Visage on himself when attacked.
Owlbear
Legendary Action: Call Consort
Once per combat, the Owlbear mother can spend a Legendary Action to  summon her mate when she is attacked.
Phase Spider Matriarch
Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb
Once per round if her offspring is attacked, the Phase Spider Matriarch can spend a Legendary Action to use  Gossamer Tomb.
Spectator
Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare
After accumulating five  Paranoid Dreams, the Spectator will spend a Legendary Action to cast  Ocular Nightmare.
Inquisitor W'wargaz
Legendary Action: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath
Twice per round, Inquisitor W'wargaz can spend a Legendary Action to summon a Mind-Claw of Tu'narath after he or his allies are struck.

Act Two

Character Action
Apostle of Myrkul
Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead
Once per round, Myrkul's Apostle can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Gaze of the Dead on a creature when attacked.
Balthazar
Legendary Action: The Dead Wastes
Once per round when a creature dies, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to create a necrotic miasma where it fell that heals Undead 4d6⁠⁠hit points and deals 4d6⁠⁠Necrotic to living creatures at the start of their turns.
Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect
Once per round, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to adopt a  Spectral Aspect after being struck.
Gerringothe Thorm
Legendary Action: Sublimation
Once per round, if she loses a piece of armour, Gerringothe Thorm can spend a Legendary Action to try and turn her enemies into gold, incapacitating them for 4 turns.
Kar'niss
Legendary Action: Fanatic Retaliation
Once per round when a  Spindleweb Fanatic is killed, Kar'niss can use a Legendary Action to possibly deal 6d10⁠⁠Psychic and  Silence the attacker.
Ketheric Thorm
Legendary Action: Hordestrike
Once per round, Ketheric can spend a Legendary Action to  Hordestrike an enemy when it is attacked by one of his minions following  Deadly Orders.
Malus Thorm
Legendary Action: Wail of Loss
Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action after being attacked to make every assistant cast  Wail of Loss simultaneously.
Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage
Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action to  Grasp a creature and pull it closer.
Oliver
Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate
Once per round, Oliver can spend a Legendary Action to summon  The Wasting Quiet in an area after a summoned shadow is slain.
Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound
Legendary Action: Wretched Growth
If a creature ends its turn within 5 m / 17 ft of the Shambling Mound, it will take 3d10⁠⁠Necrotic and Shadow-Cursed Vines will grow at its feet, possibly  Entangling it.
Thisobald Thorm
Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew
Once per round, Thisobald Thorm can use his Legendary Action when his brew is changed by a foe's attack to make it overflow, dealing 3d6 of the corresponding damage type.
Ch'r'ai Tska'an
Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice
Once per round when a humanoid dies, the Ch'r'ai can spend a legendary action to  Sacrifice its soul to ⁠Vlaakith in return for great power. Once 3 souls have been sacrificed, the Ch'r'ai takes on  Vlaakith's Undying Aspect.
Yurgir
Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush
Once per round, Yurgir can spend a Legendary Action to  Blinding Ambush a  Hunted creature when it attempts to attack or cast a spell.

Act Three

Character Action
Boon of Bhaal
Legendary Action: Bhaal's Edict
If Orin has not used her Legendary Action by the end of a round, and Orin is not duelling her opponent alone, the Dread Lord places a creature under  Bhaal's Edict.
Cazador Szarr
Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm
Once per round, Cazador can spend a Legendary Action to conjure a  Vampiric Swarm.
Crown of Karsus
 Karsite Grip
Crush a creature's being with pure Netherese energy that can fork across to three other targets within 8 m (27 ft).
Enver Gortash
Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding
Once per round, Gortash can use his Legendary Action to immediately  Brand his attacker after being struck.
Ch'r'ai Har'rak
Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace
Once per round, Ch'r'ai Har'rak can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Tu'narath's Embrace on an ally to prevent an Incapacitating Condition.
Mystic Carrion
Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath
Once per turn, Mystic Carrion can use his Legendary Action to release  Torrential Undeath at his foes when hit.
Orin
Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash
Once per round, Orin can use her Legendary Action to  Sanguine Lash after being attacked.
Ptaris
Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma
Once per round, after being hit, Ptaris can spend a Legendary Action to surround his attacker in  Ptarian Pacifism.
Raphael
Legendary Action: Beguiling Rebuke
 Beguile your attacker and its nearby allies, possibly preventing them from attacking you again.
Legendary Action: Soul Ascension
Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately cast  Soul Ascension when he or his allies are attacked.
Sarevok Anchev
Legendary Action: Murderous Retort
Once per round, Orin or Sarevok can use their Legendary Action to immediately strike back at their attacker.
Viconia DeVir
Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss
Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to cast  Sanctuary of Loss when an ally is struck.
Legendary Action: Heartwrench
Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to  Heartwrench a  Heartform Mapped creature after it strikes her or her allies.

Dragons

While all other legendary actions are exclusive to Honour mode, dragons will have legendary actions available while in Tactician. As a legendary action, dragons can react to being attacked with their breath weapon:

Character Action
Ansur
Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath
The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.
Dominated Red Dragon
Legendary Action: Draconic Fury
The dragon can retaliate against an attacker with its breath weapon once per round.
Qudenos

Notes

  1. ↑ Inquisitor W'wargaz may use their Legendary Action: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath twice per round. Gerringothe Thorm may use her legendary action as many times per round as pieces of armour are destroyed. Raphael may use legendary actions as many times per round as there are remaining soul pillars.
